# ex: bindWildcard TypeName case
ex {
	type T int
	var x T
	T(x) -> int(x)
}
-- x.go --
package m

type MyInt int

func F() MyInt {
	var x MyInt = 1
	return MyInt(x)
}
-- stderr --
